payload-written-as-plain-json-tasks.text: Payload written as plain JSON: tasks.

The story and the mapping are in the spec; slices and the gate are in the plan. One writer, one commit per slice, each commit builds. Every new check is run failing before it is made to pass and the failing run is kept.

slice-plain-mapping.text: [x] plain-mapping-red: the examples of the spec table, the refusals with their paths, the round-trip property over generated JSON, the huge-exponent number and the data without a plain reading all fail on the base because the module does not exist.
[x] plain-mapping-module: Singular.Registry.PlainJson with the mapping, the reading, the refusals, the schema type and the view.

slice-payload-schema-on-the-commands.text: Slice: payload schema on the commands.

[x] payload-schema-red: parsing the flag, the default, a bad value, the detailed-document refusal, equal data for the same file through insert, update, previews and register, and the detailed schema unchanged all fail on the base.
[x] payload-schema-flag: the entry argument, the flag declaration, help, help snapshots, parser corpora, the application settings spec, the flag table.
[x] one-payload-reader: Singular.CLI.Payload and its use in the open-datum commands, previews, keri-stub register and the negative host.
[x] callers-name-the-schema: every shell, python and Haskell caller in the repository that writes a payload file in the detailed schema passes the setting.

slice-printed-payload.text: [x] printed-payload-red: inspect and the update receipt print payload with payloadSchema in both forms; fails on the base.

[x] readers-follow-the-print: every reader of applicationOutput.payload and of the update receipt's payload in scripts, the conformance backend and controls, and tests is moved.

slice-hosted-evidence.text: [x] journey-stores-plain-and-detailed: the Demo 1 journey stores {"answer": 42} with no setting, reads it back equal with schema plain, updates it, and stores a detailed document with the setting; the same job refuses a detailed file without the setting and a plain file with the setting detailed.
[x] journey-controls-fail-on-the-previous-release: the new steps are shown refusing against the 0.14.0 binary, where a plain file is not Plutus data.
